00 · Read me — how this file works

Everything here is copied, not recreated. The markup is lifted verbatim out of the source files named on each specimen, and it is rendered against your own compiled stylesheet — public/build/assets/app-BrdwXlyq.css — so what you see is what the product renders. Icons are the real lucide glyphs, inlined. Only the data is invented.

Use the Dark / Light button top-left to flip modes. A few screens are dark-only or light-only by design in the product (the Hub, the error pages, the Next dashboard, the Settings sidebar) — those won't change.

What's in here

  • Shared card primitives, the main Overview dashboard, all 8 Reckoner metric-card bodies, and all 4 role dashboards
  • The canonical list-page pattern end to end, plus the summary strip from all 26 pages that have one
  • Profit & Loss in full, the Reports Hub cards, every modal type, and every error / blocked / access state
  • The POS terminal in full, with its modals and supporting states
  • Hub, invitations, onboarding, the coachmark tour, settings, user management, roles, permissions, banners, locks and the PIN pad
  • The product and party search dropdowns, the Add/Edit Product and Add/Edit Party popups, and the real Payment In / Payment Out screens

Known gaps

  • The long document builders (Create Invoice, Create Proposal, Create Purchase Order, Recurring Invoices) — 3,000+ lines each, mostly line-item grids that repeat the table pattern already shown
  • SuperAdmin / PlatformOwner screens and the Installer, which are not tenant-facing
  • Marketing and other public pages, deliberately excluded
  • Print / thermal receipt templates, which use their own stylesheet
